pieces.name: explain
pieces.text: But what does that mean? Our system, Itantra, lets two Android phones communicate even when there is no SIM, mobile tower, internet router connection. A speaker talks and our on -device speech -to -text model converts speech into compact text. A Bluetooth -based transport and relay layer sends the text to another phone. There, text is converted back to audible speech in the messenger's language by text -to -speech model.
